## Description

Proposed stochastic-process-based approach to ETF rotation: Rank a defined ETF universe using a specified momentum, trend, or risk signal and rotate exposure on a fixed schedule, with a defined defensive allocation and trading-cost model. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
